title: Create a new patient account and land on home
description: Verifies a new patient can sign up with required details and is redirected to the home dashboard with a visible success confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to /signup
Fill Test into the first name field
Fill 35 into the age field
Fill patient+signup1@example.com into the email field
Fill ValidPassword123! into the password field
Fill Hypertension into the condition/diagnosis field
Fill Dr Rao into the doctor name field
Fill +14155550123 into the doctor WhatsApp number field
Submit the sign up form
Verify the user lands on the home dashboard
Verify an account creation success confirmation is visible

title: Sign in and reach the home dashboard
